༄༅/ /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa bzhuṭa so/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa bzhuṭa so/ /

rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/ rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ /dpal don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ye shes rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin thugs rje'i glog phreng can/ /phan bde'i char gyis 'gro ba tshim mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i snying po las/ /zab don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'dir bsdus te/ /phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis snang bar bya/ /phyi nang 'byung ba thams cad ye shes gdangs/ /ye shes dngos las ye nas grub pas na/ /phyi yi 'byung ba'i bcud lnga la brten nas/ /nang gi 'byung pa rnam lnga'i gsos sman bshad/ dang po sa yi bcud len ni/ /sa tshil rdo tshil khrol bu gsum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bza' ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad pa bya/ /de las tshil ni/ sngon bskal pa bzang po'i dus na/ sa'i tshil zhag chags pa gad rdzong dang ri ngogs dang thang yangs bzang po la snang ba ste/ rigs lnga'i mdog dang mthun pa la sbrang rtsi'i ro ltar mngar zhing so mi seg pa ste/ rnal 'byor pas blangs la/ dang po phye dang sum cha sum gnyis/ de nas phye phyed/ rim gyis sa nyid la slob cing*/ bdag nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis khengs pa bsnams pa'i lus kyi 'khor lo lnga'i nang na/ ha ri ni sa a rnams dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gar gnas pa la/ mtha' skor du yi ge bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i mgrin pa'i ri ser po la ha a ni sa ser pos bskor ba las bdud rtsi babs pas/ lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sbyar la bsgom zhing*/ ā+oṃ ṛ ha a ni sa sid+dhi pha la āḥhūṃ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te phyogs bcu'i bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro snang srid snod bcud thams cad kyi gzi brjid dang*/

tshe dang*/ 'od zer dang nus mthu rnams rang gi mgrin pa'i yi ge nyed la thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar bsgoms nas mthar bsngo ba bya'o/ /de'ang mar dum re bcug pas gegs med cing 'byongs rtags shin tu nye'o/ /rtags su lus 'jam zhing gnyer ma med pa dang*/ sems gsal zhing ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ ngag nus che zhing byin rlabs dang ldan pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro 'du zhing kun gyis mthong na yid du 'ong ba'o/ khyad par du bdud rtsi phor re tsam brten no/ / sngo dang rjen spang*/ nyi ma dang me spang*/ thig le ma nyams par bya'o/ /rdo tshil ni rigs lnga'i kha dog gang yang rung ste/ sa med par phye nas bkrus te khal gcig la nas bre gsum/ gro bre gsum/ bra 'o bre do/ sran ma brai gang rnams dang bsres pa zhib mor rtsi bzhin btags la/ dang por btsos zan du bya ste/ phru ba thod pa'i ngo bor bsam pa'i nang du chu ran par phye dang mnyam du btso'o/ /de nyid ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ bdun gyis bdud rtsir bsams la/ dang por zhag lngar phye dang phyed bsres/ de nas bcur sum cha sum gnyis/ de nas nyi shu rtsa gcig song dus/ phye drug cha re bsres la/ zan dron byas pa mar 'gron bu tsam re bcug nas bdud rtsir bsams la/ rang nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro snga ma bzhin bsgoms te/ zos rting mgrin pa nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ lus sems bde bas rgyas par bsam la sngags de nyid bzlas te/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs thams cad rang la babs pas lus khengs par bsam la/ rlung kha sbyor yun ring du bzung nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /dam tshig tu sngau dang rjen dang*/ nyi ma dang me spang*/ bdud rtsi phor re 'thungs shing*/ rtag tu bla ma la gsol ba gdab bo/ / 'byongs pa'i rtags su lus la bde ba/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la rtogs pa 'bar zhing*/ mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du/ skyes pa bud med 'du/ zas nor gter rdol ba bzhin 'bul du 'ongs/

log 'tsho dang ser sna'i sgrib pa byang nas/ mu ge'i bskal pa las thar/ rtag tu lha'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gegs med do/ /phyis ni ji ltar dga' bas khrol bu dang skyo tsha dang spags pa'am/ thug pa'ang bya'o/ /de nas rdo khrol bur za ba la brtag pa/ bza' ba/ phan yon dang bsrungs mtshams gsum las/ dang po ni sha chen tshil chen/ rus chen dang*/ mkhris chen dang*/ shi sha dang lnga'o/ / dang po ni mdog gang yang rung ba la so mi rtse zhing snyi ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni dkar la snyi ba'o/ /gsum pa ni dkar gong dang me rdo lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni g.ya' ma ljang gu lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni rdo phal pa thams cad do/ /de'ang sha tshim gnyis las gzhan gsum mi brten no/ /rdo de dag ni spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug dang*/ kong po dang*/ rag sham brag dang*/ yar khyer dang*/ te sgro brag dkar dang*/ lha snyan dbu ri nas phar cung zad phyin pa dang*/ phag mo gru dang*/ byar smad kyi lha ri rgyab dang*/ lho brag mkhar chu dang*/ 'dab smad bya dkar mo dang*/ bzad kyi bye ma lung dang*/ 'phreng po sle'u chung gi 'chil mo dang*/ dpal gyi chu bo ri rnams na yod do/ gnyis pa la drug las/ rdo btu ba ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ste/ rta mgrin tu bsgoms pa'i sor mo lnga mkha' 'gro lnga/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang*/ rdo bdud rtsir bsgoms la/ ā+oṃ trig yer swā hās btus la/ de nas bza' thabs dngos ni/ khrol bu de ka bzhin bza'/ zan dron yang de ka dang 'dra/ 'gams phye la skyo tsha dang sngags/ skyo tsha'am sngo dang bsres nas tshod ma byed pa'ang nyan no/ /sdor ni gang yang rung*/ tshwa gdab/ de'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsams la/ ā+oṃ mu le mu le mahā mu le swāhā/ ā+oṃ gor chun gor chun swāhā/ zhes bzlas la/ rang nyid rta mgrin du gsal bas bza'o/ /gegs sel ni tshe 'di blos btang*/ snying rje dang ldan pas/

dang po za ba'i tshe mar mthe bong tsam re rdo za ba'i snga phyir btang*/ chu bskol la mar btab la btung*/ des gegs mi 'byung nges so/ /phan yon dang bsrungs mtshams ni/ mar nag mi za/ phud gzhan la mi sbyin/ dkon mchog mchod/ gsog 'jog mi bya/ sngags 'dren dus ngag gcad/ thig le ma nyams par bsrung ngo*/ /de'ang rim gyis rdo grangs byas la mar byung dus tshang ngam blta'o/ /phyis mi dgos/ yog tshad zos pas chog zas kyi sred pa 'chad/ sha skyai zhing dkar la snum pa'o/ /shes pa dngas/ dbang po gsal/ ro mchog thon/ lus la srog chags mi 'byung*/ drod skyes/ mkha' 'gro 'du/ mngon shes skye'o/ /de ltar sa yi bcud len byas pa yin/ log 'tsho med cing sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ dngos grub nye zhing bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug/ mkha' 'gro 'du zhing ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub/ mdor na phan yon dpag tu med pa yin/ sa'i bcud len bdud rtsi yang zhun ces bya ba rdzogs so/ /a+thi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas chu'i bcud len ni/ /bdud rtsi dngul chu'i sbyor ba ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bza' ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes/ /sngon 'gro rdzas bsag rab gnas ni/ /dngul chu mu zis btul ba ni/ /srang lnga sgog skya de dang mnyam/ /dbang lag nye shing ra mnye ba/ /a ba sbrul sha rtag tu ngu*/ /srang re tshogs na shin tu rab/ /gla rtsi shu dag gu gul nag /li shi tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis/ /star bu shing kun brag zhun dang*/ cu gang dzā ti ghi hang dang*/ /rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha/ /shing tsha bca' lga pi pi ling*/ /se 'bru sug smel a ru ra/ /a ka ru ni nag po dang*//mgron bu bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams/ /ci 'byor phye mar rtsi bzhin bya//cong zhi bre phyed dang bsres nas/ /klad par bsdus te yun ring bsna/ོ/ dngul mdangs rtsig rtsig byung ba dang*/ /ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam/ /byas te rin chen snod du blugs/

/tshes bcu nyi shu lnga la sogs/ /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshod du/ /tshogs gtor bshams la ril bu rnams/ /mkha' 'gro sde sngar gsal btab la/ /ye shes bcug cing mchod bstod bya/ /'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang sems bla ma mkha' 'gro yi/ /dngos grub byin rlabs kun bsdus la/ /ril bu'i mkha' 'gror thim par bsam/ ā+oṃ a ha ri ni sa sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ 'di dang rten 'brel snying po yis/ /me tog dor nas bkra shis brjod/ /tshogs kyi dga' ston rgya cher bya/ /de ni rab tu gnas pa 'o/ /nas ni dkar la bzang ba la/ /gro phye bre gsum skyo tsha byas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi bza' thabs ni/ /tho rangs langs te skyil krung bya// rlung ro lan gsum phyir phul la/ /las dang sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ /de nas ril bu mid nas ni/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ldan pa yis/ /rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dkar gsal zhal gcig spyan gsum mdzes/ /g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum mi ro gnon/ /gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje gri gug dang*/ /thod khrag bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /me long dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga dang*/ /lte ba gsang gnas rnam pa lngar/ /dkar ser mthing ga dmar ljang gi /rtsa 'dab 'khor lo rnam lnga'i dbus/ /ro rkyang dbu ma ka ba bzhin/ /'khor lo lnga na yig 'bru lnga/ /ha ri a ni sa gnas pa'i/ /phyogs bzhir rang gnas 'khor lo bzhi'o/ /dbu ma sbubs stong yar sne na/ /bde chen 'khor lor haṃ gnas te/ /lte bar ni dmar me stag 'dra/ /gsang ba'i yaṃ las rlung byung bas/ /ni las me 'bar haṃ la phog /thig le dmar po'i me 'od kyis/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib sha khrag rnams/ /bsregs sbyangs lan ni bdun pa'i rjes/ /haṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun/ /rkang mthil spyi gtsug gang bar babs/ /phyogs bcu'i bla ma mkha' 'gro dang*/

/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /snang srid snod bcud bdun rtsir gyur/ /bdag gi lus la thim pa yis/ /tshe dpal gzi brjid 'od dang ldan/ /byin rlabs dngos grub thob par bsam/ /bde stong dbyer med ngang la gzhag /rjes ni bsngo bas rgyas gdab bya/ /zhag ni gsum gsum ril bu re/ /nyi nyu rtsa gcig gong du bza'/ /de nas 'byor tshad zos pas chog /chang zhim phor re btung bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes la rnam gsum ste/ /rtags dang gegs sel phan yon no/ /rtags ni phyi nang gsang ba ste/ /phyi rtags gnyid chung shes pa gsal/ /lus yang bde drod skye ba 'o/ /nang rtags rmi lam mkha' la 'gro /chos 'chad skye bos bstod pa dang*/ /bsnyen bkur zhabs tog byed pa rmis/ /gsang rtags phyi ru snang ba ni/ /lus ni bcu drug lon pa 'dra/ /rgas nas so 'u skye ba dang*/ /mngon par shes pa 'char ba dang*/ /mkha' 'gro mtsho la ngang pa bzhin/ /'du zhing dngos grub sna tshogs ster/ /grub pa brgyad kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gegs sel gtum mo bsgoms pa dang*/ /bla ma la gus gsol ba gdab/ /nad ni tsha grang gang langs kyang*/ /de dang mthun pa'i sman gyis gso/ /gdon la snying rje byang sems bsgom/ /des ni gegs med yon tan 'grub/ /spyir na 'di la gegs med de/ /mkha' 'gros gegs sel dngos grub ster/ /gal srid byung yang 'jigs mi dgos/ /zhag grangs them dus gegs las grol/ /dam tshig sngo ngad spang ba dang*/ /me dang nyi ma tshwa rnams spang*/ /thig le bsrung zhing bde stong bsgom/ /phan yon lus sems bde stong bskyed/ /nad gdon mdze rigs dug rnams zhi/ /mkha' 'gro 'du zhing ci bsam 'grub/ /'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob/ /'di 'dra'i gdams pa yid bzhin 'dra/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig cha rkyen du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /chu'i bcud len bde chen rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rdzogs so/

/a+thi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas me yi bcud len ni/ /gtum mo bde drod ye shes gos/ rnal 'byor pa yis bgo ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo pad+ma'i rigs dmar mo/ gcer bu pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dpa' mo'i rgyan rdzogs par bskyed la/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag dang*/ rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu/ mgrin par bcu drug /snying gar sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bsam pa'i dbus su dbu ma sbubs stong pa'i yar sna tshangs bug /mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas ro rkyang gnyis 'khor lo lnga la 'khyud nas klad pa'i steng na tshur byung ste/ smin mtshams nas sna bug gnyis su tshud par bsam/ de gnyis kyi mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi na dbu ma'i nang du tshud par bsam/ rtsa gsum po de mda' smyug tsam pa dmar por bsam/ de nas rlung ro drag po gsum phyir phul la/ sna bug gnyis na tshur 'jam la ring bar nang du drangs la rtsa gnyis nas mar phus btab pa bzhin song bas gsang gnas su dbu ma'i nang du tshud par bsams/ gsang bar sa dmar po zhig kyang bsgom/ de rlung gis bus pas dmar lam gyis byung bas lte ba'i rtsa mdud na pad+ma ḍā ki yab yum sbyor ba'i gsang gnas las/ bdud rtsi babs pas gsang ba'i rtsa bdud gang bar bsgom zhing*/ rlung thub thang du bzung zhing*/ cung zad re brngubs la mnan/ yang phyed tsam re dal bus phyir btang la lhag ma gzung*/ gtong dus sna bug gnyis na phar dal bur song ba'i tshe/ kun dhar ma'i nang nas tshangs pa'i bu gar sngo sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas gsang gnas su drod phebs te dwangs ma 'chor bar 'dug na/ lte ba nas gtum mo sbar la snying gar snga ma bzhin bsgom/

de nas mgrin par bsgoms pas snying gar drod skyes dus spyi bor sbar la bsgom mo/ /des ni rtsa bye nas dwangs ma rgyas te/ bde drod 'bar bas lus la gos mi dgos snum la dro zhing dwangs/ sems la bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char zhing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub chen po thob/ tsha ེ gcig gis rig 'dzin gyi sa non par 'gyur ro/ /bde chen ye shes gtum mo'i me 'od kyis/ /bde gshegs khams rnams ma lus rab rgyas nas/ /bde chen mi 'gyur 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /bde gshegs rnams dang skal pa mnyam par shog /gtum mo me'i bcud len bde drod 'bar ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /a+thi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas rlung gis bcud len ni/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul skye ba stai/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de la gyen rgyu thur sel/ mnyam gnas gsum ni/ pho mo ma ning gi dbye bas te/ drag pa dang*/ 'jam pa dang*/ mnyam par gnas te/ las kyi rlung btung nas ye shes kyi rlung sbyang ba'i phyir/ dus bzhir rlung gi rim pa bsgom pa ni/ dgun grang ba chu yi dus su me'i rlung dmar zhing dro ba gzung ngo*/ /dpyid bad kan sa'i dus na rlung gi rlung 'byed cing 'thor ba ljang khu mnyam par gzung ngo*/ /dbyar tsha ba me'i dus su chu'i rlung dkar zhing bsil ba gzung ngo*/ /ston smin byed rlung gi dus su sa'i rlung dal 'jam ser po gzung ngo*/ /de yang stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ rang nyid las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyis yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i/ 'khor lo lnga snga ma bzhin gsal btab la rlung ro gsum phyung nas/ rlung rab tu dal ba gsum tshur byung ba ro rkyang gnyis nas dbu mar zhugs/ 'khor lo lnga rgyu ma phus btab pa bzhin song*/

gsang ba'i sa ljang gu ha ri ni as bskor ba la gsal stong gnyis med kyi ye shes skye bar bsam zhing thub thang re bzung la phyir dal bus phyed tsam re gtong ngo*/ /de yang bum pa can du bskyil ba'o/ /de bzhin du rlung rab tu dal bas phyi nang du mnyam zhing gzung ba ni/ 'jam pa stai khong seng can du sba ba'o/ /de bzhin du rlung gi 'gro 'ong shin tu dal bas mi tshor bar byas te/ sems gsal stong gi ngang la 'jog pa ni nam mkha' can du sba ba ste/ ma ning zhes bshad do/ /de gsum gang byed kyang dus bzhi'i rlung gi rjes 'brang bas/ rlung skyon med cing ye shes myur du skye'o/ /langs dus bsngo ba byas la/ lus thams cad dkrugs shing bcus te bskor la mnyam par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas lus yang zhing mgyogs pas rkang mgyogs 'grub/ sems gsal la dwangs pas mngon shes 'grub/ rnam rtog 'gro 'ong chad pas ye shes 'grub/ rtag tu lus sems bde zhing snying po'i don la reg/ rtsa las su rung bas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung*/ rlung las su rung bas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la dbang bsgyur/ mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du/ dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung*/ myur du gdod ma'i ka dag gsal stong chen por mya ngan las 'da' 'o/ /de yang 'od gsal dang bsres nas bsgom pa ni mchog tu gces so/ /rlung gi bcud len dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ ༵a+thi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas nam mkha'i bcud len ni/

/ zag med ye shes bskyed pa ste/ / rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom pa'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ / dwangs shing mtho ba'i sar song ste/ nam mkha' dwangs pa'i tshe skad cig gis rang nyid sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mthing ga 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor lo lnga dang rtsa gsum gsal btab ste/ rlung phyir 'gro dus las dang sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sang sang phar song bar bsam zhing*/ nang du brngubs dus nam mkha' sngo skya thams cad na ra ra byung ste ro rkyang nas dbu ma dnga'akhor lo lnga gang bas ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam ste thub thang nang du mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin du phyi'i nam mkha' nang gi nam mkha' la thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bur bsams pa'i ngang la shes pa gsal stong 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes la gzhag go /de nas phyi'i sa rdo ri brag la sogs snang srid thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur te nang gi nam mkha' rnams par dag pa'i nam mkha'i ngang du thim par bsam zhing mnyam par gzhag go /skabs su lus dang phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur te/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' gnyis 'dres pa ni/ bum pa chag pas bum nang gi nam mkha' dang nam mkha' chen por dbye ba med pa bzhin gsal stong mtha' bral gyi ngang la phyam gyis mnyam par bzhag pas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i don mngon sum du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo nam mkha' ltar chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral bar zhi zhing thim nas/ gdod ma ye stong ka dag chen po/ skye med bsam yul las 'das pa'i don mngon 'gyur te/ tshe 'dir rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i ngang der 'bad rtsol dang bral ba grol ba yang yod do/ /phal cher bar do'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi skad cig dang por don de nyid goms pa dang*/

'dres nas ka dag gi sa la rang grol lo/ /de'ang rnam shes nam mkha' la thim pa'i tshe phyi'i nam mkha' sprin med pa ltar stong gsal gdod nas dag pa'i snang ba 'char la/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa'i tshe/ phyi'i nam mkha' nang gi nam mkha' dang 'dres pa ltar bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngon bas 'phags par 'char ba de nyid/ gzhi'i 'od gsal du rang ngo shes pas da lta sbyangs pa'i 'od gsal bu'i ye shes dang 'dres te gnyis med gcig tu grol lo/ /de'i tshe phyi nang gi nam mkha' dbye ba med pa ltar lus rdos bcas bor/ sems chos nyid gdod ma'i ye shes su nub/ ye shes 'od gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang*/ nang gsal ka dag gi ye shes gcig tu gnas pas chos sku bsal bzhag dang bral ba/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' la dbye ba med pa ltar/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang du gnas te/ phra ba'i ye shes gsal dwangs gzhi la mi g.yo bar gnas pa tsam las/ phyi nang gi 'dzin pa gang yang med pa'i rang bzhin shel sgong dri ma dang bral ba ltar/ ka dag chos zad kyi gnas lugs gdod ma'i grol gzhi chen po nyid du 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gsal ba'i cha tsam las me long g.ya' dag pa ltar/ sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi phyir gsal du 'byung ba mi 'gags pas/ gzugs sku phun gsum tshogs pa'i snang ba ston la/ nang gsal phra ba thugs rje'i cha tsam las 'gro ba'i gnas dang dbang po dang skye ba la sogs pa mkhyen nas gang la gang 'dul ston pa'i sprul pa 'phrul bas sems can gyi don lhun grub tu byed kyang gdod ma'i ngang nam mkha' lta bu chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang las g.yos pa med do/ de ltar gdod ma'i gnas lugs gsal por bshad pa ste/ legs par bkral na nam mkha' lta bu las gzhan med do/ /zab mo'i chos tshul rgya mtsho thams cad nas/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bur gsungs pa'i don de yin no/ /de ltar gsungs kyang gzhan du brjod pa dag mi gsal zhing go bar dka' la/

'dir go sla zhing gsal por brjod pa'o/ /dbu ma rab tu mi gnas pas de'i tshe ye shes rgyun chad par 'dod pa ni sems sems byung gi spros pa dbyings su zhi ba tsam la dgongs so/ /'dir rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen pos sems sems byung gi spros pa ma lus pa dbyings su zhi bas gdod ma'i ye shes nang gsal phra ba'i rig pa thugs rje'i snying po can du gnas pa las sems can gyi don byed par 'dod do/ /snga mas smon lam gyis don byed pa las thugs rjes don byed par khas mi len no/ /dngos por smra ba ni sangs rgyas dngos por sku dang ye shes grub pa ltar da ltar gyi sems can rang rgyud pa ltar 'dod de/ de dag ni rtag pa'i mthar lhung la/ ye shes rgyun chad nas smon lam gyis don byed pa ni chad pa'i mthar lhung pas/ de gnyis ka bsal te phra ba'i ye shes gsal ba'i cha las stong pa rig pa'i snying po can du lhun gyis grub pa'i don la 'jug pa yin no/ /de'i tshe ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mthar ma lhung*/ rang bzhin gsal bas chad pa'i mthar ma lhung*/ thugs rjes khyab pas sems can gyi don 'bad med lhun grub chen por bzhugs pa yin no/ /'di ni rab tu gsang ba'i snying po mthar thug pa'o/ /nam mkha'i bcud len ye shes gsang skor zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /a+thi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ de ltar ma dag 'byung ba'i thabs nyid las/ /dag pa'i ye shes bskyed pa gsang ba'i lam/ /rdo rje snying po'i theg pa mthar thug ste/ / ma lus 'gro kun gnad 'dis grol bar shog /sa yi bcud len 'byung ba'i lus bzung ste/ /chu dang me yis bde chen mchog bskyed nas/ /rlung gis gsal stong nam mkhas mi rtog nyid/ /sku gsum sa la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni mthar thug nges pa'i snying po ste/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig sbas pa'i sgo phye nas/ /gangs ri thod dkar 'phags pa'i ri ngogs su/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/

/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /gzhi rdzogs 'od gsal snying po'i zhing khams su/ /ma lus phyam gcig thams cad byang chub nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par shog /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe bkod ba rdzogs so// //'di nyid gsang zhing phangs par bya/ /kun la mi bstan nyams su blangs/ /las 'brel rtsal gyi khyad chos yin/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig man ngag yin/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa/ -PAGE 220--PAGE 219--PAGE 217-
